question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

On the cards
solution:
The correct answer is **'Likely to happen'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'On the cards' **is** 'Likely to happen'.**
 
• **On the cards:** likely to happen. (संभावित)
 
 
• *Example: Their marriage has been **on the cards** for some time now.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Likely to happen.*
